cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/10_left: ^6Price^7: It should be taking off any time now. Make sure you're on that C-130!
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/bomber_inbound: ^4Overlord^7: Viking Six, you've got ^1suicide bombers^7 inbound to your position.
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/c130_all_players: ^6Price^7: We need EVERYONE on that plane.
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/c130_infil: ^6Price^7: C-130 is arriving soon. Get into that Plane!
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/call_exfil: ^6Price^7:  Bring up your tablet and hold ^5[{+usereload,+activate}]^7 to call for an exfil.
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/convoy_2: ^4Overlord^7: The convoy has been crippled! Our pilot is running for safety!
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/convoy_3: ^4Overlord^7: Pilot has moved to a safe location. The enemy convoy is escaping!
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/convoy_4: ^4Overlord^7: Pilot secure, get moving to the LZ now!
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/convoy_5: ^4Overlord^7: Viking Six, the pilot is being moved towards an enemy convoy.
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/convoy_6: ^4Overlord^7: Viking Six, the enemy is moving with the pilot on foot towards a column of vehicles.
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/convoy_roaming: ^4Price^7: We need to fulton capture 15 barrels of nitrate from the nearby convoys.
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/disguise_choice: ^6Price^7: Shooting or Killing anyone will give your position away. Your call on that Soldier.
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/equip_disguise: ^6Price^7: Al-Qatala clothes and weapons are at the top of the Control tower; Everyone equip the Al-Qatala Disguise!
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/exfil_auto: ^6Price^7: Heli is on it's way to bring you home. Look for the Exfil marker and watch out for enemy reinforcements while you wait.
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/found_keycard: ^6Price^7: Great work. This keycard will help us quickly issue a Land request to the C130. Insert it into the Laptop!
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/gimme_60: ^6Price^7: I give it about 60 seconds till they realize something's wrong. Get on that plane NOW!
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/got_disguise_earl: ^6Price^7: Interesting. You've found an Al-Qatala disguise. This would help us get onto the C-130 to retrieve the nuclear core.
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/goto_c130: ^6Price^7: Make your way into that C-130.
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/grab_disguise: ^6Price^7: You will now need a way to get onto the plane. Your best bet is to get a disguise.
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/grab_that_core: ^6Price^7: Find and Grab that Nuclear Core
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/hack_laptop: ^6Price^7: Jam their Comms to disrupt communication
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/hack_radar_done: ^6Price^7: C-130 is approaching to land. Great work!
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/heli_down: ^4Overlord^7: Viking Six, we've got a bird down in the city.
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/heli_down_1: ^4Overlord^7: We need to secure the crash site, but we could lose Dr. Morales.
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/ied_ahead: ^4Overlord^7: Use ^1Overwatch^7 to mark ^1IED^7's along your route.
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/infil_c130_fail: ^6Price^7: You failed to get onto the C-130 before it took off.
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/keycard_success: ^6Price^7: You found a way to get the C-130 to land. Impressive.
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/morales_1: ^4Overlord^7: Intel is showing Dr. Morales is being held in a nearby safehouse.
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/morales_10: ^4Overlord^7: Good work, Viking Six. Birds are inbound for extraction.
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/morales_11: ^4Overlord^7: Viking Six, exfil bird is close by. Move with the HVI extraction!
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/morales_12: ^4Overlord^7: You have to get Morales to safety! Move to the new exfil location
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/morales_13: ^4Overlord^7: Dr. Morales is safe in the chopper. Great job!
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/morales_3: ^4Overlord^7: The HVI has been relocated. Access the laptop nearby to track her.
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/morales_4: ^4Overlord^7: Defend your position while you decrypt the information in that laptop.
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/morales_5: ^4Overlord^7: HVI located. Marking her position now.
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/morales_6: ^4Overlord^7: Viking Six, jackpot on Dr. Morales. Move towards our LZ for extraction.
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/morales_7: ^4Overlord^7: Viking Six, you've got a large group of enemy fighters inbound. Advise you set up defensive positions and wait for extraction.
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/new_obj: ^6Price^7: Shoot that plane down and recover the Nuclear Core!
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/pilot_stop: ^4Overlord^7:  Let's hope he can hold out for now…
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/repair_vehicle_in: ^4Overlord^7: Viking Six, get that vehicle repaired, you're sitting ducks out there!
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/sandstorm_1: ^6Price^7: Heads up team. We have Weather reports warning us about a Sandstorm. Stay Frosty
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/sandstorm_3: ^6Price^7: This is your chance. Get the Al-Qatala disguise NOW since visibility is poor
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/sandstorm_4: ^6Price^7: Alright.  You will have to wait till the next sandstorm to get the disguise. ETA incoming in a few
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/save_lives: ^6Price^7: The Nuclear core is in our possession. You have saved countless lives.
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/saved_morales_exf: ^6Price^7: Great Job squad.  Dr. Morales is safe and sound, and will help our cause.
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/saved_pilot_exfil: ^6Price^7: Great Job squad.  Our pilot is recovered and is waiting to bring you boys home.
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/seated: ^6Price^7: (Whispers) - You're in position. Wait for the plane to take off before making any moves
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/stay_seat: ^6Price^7: (Whispers) - Do not compromise your position. Stay in your seat till the C130 is completely in the air
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/use_assault_drone: ^4Overlord^7: Use Assault Drone to your advantage.
cp_br_syrk_gl_dialogue/wait_sandy: ^6Price^7: Wait till the Sandstorm arrives before equipping the disguise

cp_br_syrk_objectives/shoot_threat: ^1Enemy: ^7 STOP! Don't come closer or I'll shoot him!!
cp_br_syrk_objectives/shoot_threat2: ^2Pilot: ^7Don't listen to him! Take him out now!! Don't worry about me!
cp_br_syrk_objectives/tmtyl_desc: Interrogate the officers in three enemy squads.
cp_br_syrk_objectives/weapons_free: Price: Weapons Free. Eliminate all the Terrorists. Remember, No American.
cp_convoys/dialog_grab_loot_20: ^4Price^7: Quickly mark them before that truck explodes!
cp_convoys/dialog_intro_01: ^4Price^7: You're approaching an area controlled by several Al-Qatala convoys.
cp_convoys/dialog_intro_02: ^4Price^7: Each seems to be carrying cargo filled with munitions barrels.
cp_convoys/dialog_intro_03: ^4Price^7: We'll need you to use your tablet to scan them for any radioactivity.
cp_convoys/dialog_intro_04: ^4Price^7: If you find any radioactive barrels we'll send in a gunship to collect them via Fulton Capture.
cp_convoys/dialog_intro_05: ^4Price^7: Careful though, if these barrels are caught in any explosions, they're sure to start a chain reaction.
cp_convoys/dialog_located_e: ^4Price^7: Another convoy has been located nearby, to your East.
cp_convoys/dialog_located_n: ^4Price^7: Another convoy has been located nearby, to your North.
cp_convoys/dialog_located_s: ^4Price^7: Another convoy has been located nearby, to your South.
cp_convoys/dialog_located_w: ^4Price^7: Another convoy has been located nearby, to your West.
cp_convoys/dialog_mission_complete: ^4Price^7: Great job, we've taken a lot of munitions off their hands.
cp_convoys/dialog_secure_loot_10: ^4Price^7: Excellent work, we're sending in a drone to collect the cargo now.
cp_convoys/dialog_secure_loot_20: ^4Price^7: Great job, a drone is coming in now.
cp_convoys/extract_nitrate: Scan the Barrels for Radioactivity before the Truck Explodes!

cp_obj_tmtyl_dialogue/go_to_next: ^4^4Overlord^7^7: We located a new target nearby.  Get the drive he's carrying.
cp_obj_tmtyl_dialogue/leader_interrogate: ^4^4Overlord^7^7: Good going.  He spilled the beans.  Leave him there, or do as you please.
cp_obj_tmtyl_dialogue/leader_killed: ^4^4Overlord^7^7: You killed the officer without taking his drive.  Prepare for enemy reinforcements
cp_obj_tmtyl_dialogue/leader_subdued: ^4^4Overlord^7^7: You subdued that officer.  Good Job.  Grab his data drive.
cp_obj_tmtyl_dialogue/obj_description: Find the squad leaders and take their data drives.
cp_obj_tmtyl_dialogue/tmtyl_failure: ^4^4Overlord^7^7: You killed our targets before getting the data.  We'll have to send in another team to fetch it.
cp_obj_tmtyl_dialogue/tmtyl_final_leader: ^4^4Overlord^7^7: This is it.  We located our main target in the large building.  Proceed.
cp_obj_tmtyl_dialogue/tmtyl_intro_1: ^4^4Overlord^7^7: Our main target is hiding somewhere in Torez.
cp_obj_tmtyl_dialogue/tmtyl_intro_2: ^4^4Overlord^7^7: Find him by acquiring data from his squad officers
cp_obj_tmtyl_dialogue/tmtyl_intro_3: ^4^4Overlord^7^7: Take out all their squad members and isolate the officers.
cp_obj_tmtyl_dialogue/tmtyl_intro_4: ^4^4Overlord^7^7: Do NOT kill the officers.  We need their data drives.
cp_obj_tmtyl_dialogue/tmtyl_intro_5: ^4^4Overlord^7^7: Convince them to cooperate by meleeing them.
cp_obj_tmtyl_dialogue/tmtyl_success: ^4^4Overlord^7^7: Jackpot.  Good job, soldiers. Mission Complete
cp_obj_tmtyl_dialogue/vip_id: ^4^4Overlord^7^7: That's him alright.  Isolate and subdue him.
cp_obj_tmtyl_dialogue/vip_recovered: ^4^4Overlord^7^7: He's too close to his friends. He's back in combat
cp_obj_tmtyl_dialogue/vipchase_intro: ^4^4Overlord^7^7: Your target is in that supermarket.  Do not kill him, and do not let him escape.  Wait for the clear to subdue and interrogate him.
cp_obj_tmtyl_dialogue/wolf_clear_snipers: ^4^4Overlord^7^7: Don't alert our main targets.  Clear the area first of snipers quickly.
cp_obj_tmtyl_dialogue/wolf_early_hvt_dea: ^4^4Overlord^7^7: The hornets nest has been kicked.  Mission Failed. Get to the exfil now!
cp_obj_tmtyl_dialogue/wolf_holdout: ^4^4Overlord^7^7: You have a very large number of hostiles coming to you.  Hole up for exfil, in 60 seconds.
cp_obj_tmtyl_dialogue/wolf_right_mark: ^4^4Overlord^7^7: Bingo.  You killed the right mark and disabled their defenses.  Hold for exfil.
cp_obj_tmtyl_dialogue/wolf_subobjs_end: ^4^4Overlord^7^7: Time to take the shot.  Kill the correct mark now.
cp_obj_tmtyl_dialogue/wolf_subobjs_hack: ^4^4Overlord^7^7: An encrypted computer in the area could hold more data on our mark.  Hack it
cp_obj_tmtyl_dialogue/wolf_subobjs_hosta: ^4^4Overlord^7^7: A small time officer in the area will have more information on him about our mark.  Dispatch him.
cp_obj_tmtyl_dialogue/wolf_subobjs_start: ^4^4Overlord^7^7: Our mark could be any of them.  Can't risk alerting him with gunfire and risk him escaping.
cp_obj_tmtyl_dialogue/wolf_subobjs_termi: ^4^4Overlord^7^7: There's a terminal nearby.  Try to find more information on our target.
cp_obj_tmtyl_dialogue/wolf_use_outlooks: ^4^4Overlord^7^7: Get a visual on our mark.  He may be accompanied.
cp_obj_tmtyl_dialogue/wolf_wrong_mark: ^4^4Overlord^7^7: That wasn't the right mark.  They activated their heavy defenses, prepare for a tough fight.
